description: Transitous provides a community-run international public-transport routing service using open GTFS and real-time feeds and free software engines. The provider is Transitous community. Geographical and temporal coverage: Coverage follows contributed feeds across regional and national borders; service completeness varies by area. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): AGPL-3.0-or-later, GPL-3.0-or-later and CC0-1.0 (per-file licences under REUSE). The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The project states service goals, including privacy and neutrality. Feed freshness and operational availability were not measured. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
